fr_html: Le PRESIDENT est d'avis que l'expression „un accord intervenu entre les parties“ dans le dernier alinéa de l'article 1er, couvre le cas visé par M. Hagerup.
en_html: The PRESIDENT was of the opinion that the expression "the subject of an agreement between the parties" in the last paragraph of Article 1 would cover the case mentioned by M. Hagerup.
